scripts.redis:setup: powershell -Command "$r=Get-Process redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if(-not $r){Start-Process 'redis-win\redis-server.exe' -ArgumentList '--port 6379 --bind 127.0.0.1 --protected-mode no --save \"\"' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep 2}; .\redis-win\redis-cli.exe ping"
scripts.dev: npm run redis:setup && concurrently --kill-others -n "AI,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,green,blue" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run redis:setup && concurrently --kill-others -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "green,blue,cyan" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 http://localhost:3001/api/health/db && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.electron:dist: npm run electron:build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
